content: This course focuses on discourse in English language education, which has continually adapted to changes within and across social, cultural, political and technological contexts and communities. Through lectures and discussions, students will not only learn a range of concepts, theories, and methods but also relate ideas and examples from the texts to research studies in the relevant topic area. Students will demonstrate knowledge of the topic through discussion, analysis, and research.
books:
1. Flowerdew, J. (2013). Discourse in English language education. London: Routledge
2. Selected readings
